paragraphs.en: Not every maintenance decision concerns factual truth. A memory can remain accurate yet become redundant, rarely useful, or overly costly to keep active. Forgetting regulates whether and how such records continue to influence later behavior. Hard deletion permanently removes a record from its persistent store; expiration deactivates it according to a predefined retention window or inactivity schedule; and soft suppression retains the record while lowering its retrieval priority or accessibility. MemoryBank uses time-dependent memory strength decay, whereas VerMem supports soft deletion with retained history Zhong et al. [2024] , Sun et al. [2026] . These capacity- and utility-driven forgetting mechanisms differ fundamentally from epistemic temporal invalidation during revision. Invalidation updates the temporal or contextual scope of a claim to record that it no longer holds in the current state, without erasing the historical evidence or evicting the record. Although both operations can reduce a memory’s future influence, factual validity (whether a claim still holds) and retrieval availability (whether a record remains accessible) are distinct properties. Choosing among these operations requires diagnosing whether the issue is outdated knowledge, unwanted retrieval interference, or storage cost.
paragraphs.zh: 并非每个维护决策都关乎事实真伪。 一条记忆可能仍然准确，却已变得冗余、鲜有用处，或维持其活跃状态的成本过高。 遗忘机制调节此类记录是否以及如何继续影响后续行为。 硬删除将记录从其持久存储中永久移除；过期机制依据预定义的保留窗口或失活时间表将其停用；而软抑制则保留记录，但降低其检索优先级或可访问性。 MemoryBank 使用随时间变化的记忆强度衰减，而 VerMem 支持保留历史记录的软删除 Zhong et al. [2024], Sun et al. [2026]。 这些由容量和效用驱动的遗忘机制，与修订过程中的认知性时间失效有着根本区别。 失效更新某个断言的时间或上下文范围，以记录其在当前状态下不再成立，但不会抹除历史证据或移除该记录。 尽管这两种操作都能降低一条记忆的未来影响力，但事实有效性（某断言是否仍然成立）与检索可用性（某记录是否仍可访问）是两种不同的属性。 在这些操作之间做出选择，需要判断问题究竟在于知识过时、不必要的检索干扰，还是存储成本。

paragraphs.en: Intentional forgetting aims to reduce unwanted influence, whereas catastrophic forgetting refers to the unintended loss of knowledge or capabilities that remain useful after further learning Luo et al. [2025] . In external memory, useful information may also become functionally unavailable even when the record survives Yu et al. [2026a] . The presence of a Delete action in systems such as AgeMem and UMA establishes a possible operation, not an effective policy for selective forgetting Yu et al. [2026b] , Zhang et al. [2026e] . Nor does deleting a source record necessarily remove its influence from summaries or procedures derived from it. Conversely, consolidation can discard useful evidence without any explicit deletion Zhang et al. [2026a] , Yang et al. [2026b] . Where future usefulness is uncertain and continued retention is permitted, reversible suppression or archival may be preferable to irreversible removal. Maintenance should preserve still-useful knowledge, reduce harmful influence, and retain enough evidence to recover from a premature update or deletion. The next question is whether the policies that make these choices can themselves improve from feedback.

paragraphs.en: The preceding subsections describe how experience enters memory, how it is organized and used, and how it is maintained as conditions change. We now turn to the control of these operations, asking whether feedback can change how the agent manages future experience.
paragraphs.zh: 前面几个小节描述了经验如何进入记忆、如何被组织和使用，以及当条件变化时如何被维护。 现在我们转向对这些操作的控制，探讨反馈是否能够改变智能体管理未来经验的方式。

paragraphs.en: The state and policy updates in Equations ( 3.1 ) and ( 3.2 ) target different objects of adaptation. Persistent memory state ℳ t \mathcal{M}_{t} can continually evolve even when the policy-update rule 𝒰 \mathcal{U} leaves π t mem \pi_{t}^{\mathrm{mem}} static, and a fixed policy can already select different operations across contexts. To avoid conflating these mechanisms, we distinguish three levels at which task feedback can enter the lifecycle: (1) state-level incorporation , where feedback is written into ℳ t \mathcal{M}_{t} as new experience under a fixed policy; (2) offline policy training , where downstream task objectives optimize π mem \pi^{\mathrm{mem}} prior to deployment (as in AgeMem and UMA Yu et al. [2026b] , Zhang et al. [2026e] ), after which the learned controller remains frozen; and (3) online policy evolution , where accumulated deployment feedback continually modifies how future memory operations are selected or configured ( π t mem → π t + 1 mem \pi_{t}^{\mathrm{mem}}\to\pi_{t+1}^{\mathrm{mem}} ). Online policy evolution is therefore an advanced layer of adaptation rather than a prerequisite for all memory-centric continual learning.

paragraphs.en: Existing systems illustrate how feedback operates across these levels. At the state level, Reflexion stores verbal reflections derived from task outcomes, and Voyager uses execution verification to admit procedures into its skill library Shinn et al. [2023] , Wang et al. [2024b] ; both improve subsequent behavior by enriching ℳ t \mathcal{M}_{t} without altering the underlying memory management rules. At the controller-training level, AgeMem and UMA optimize memory-action selection against downstream rewards, while VerMem supplies verifier-derived supervision for memory transitions during training Yu et al. [2026b] , Zhang et al. [2026e] , Sun et al. [2026] . The critical distinction lies in what the feedback updates and when that update occurs: storing feedback modifies available experience ( ℳ t \mathcal{M}_{t} ), whereas training or adapting a controller modifies the decision mechanism ( π mem \pi^{\mathrm{mem}} ). Closing the full policy-evolution loop requires keeping π t mem \pi_{t}^{\mathrm{mem}} open to continual revision during deployment across formation, consolidation, retrieval, and maintenance, rather than treating feedback merely as a final post-processing step.

sents.en: The critical distinction lies in what the feedback updates and when that update occurs: storing feedback modifies available experience ( ℳ t \mathcal{M}_{t} ), whereas training or adapting a controller modifies the decision mechanism ( π mem \pi^{\mathrm{mem}} ).

sents.en: Closing the full policy-evolution loop requires keeping π t mem \pi_{t}^{\mathrm{mem}} open to continual revision during deployment across formation, consolidation, retrieval, and maintenance, rather than treating feedback merely as a final post-processing step.

paragraphs.en: When memory-management rules change, the stability–plasticity trade-off also applies to the process that controls future learning. An overly aggressive policy may repeatedly overwrite useful evidence, whereas an overly conservative policy may reject experience needed for adaptation. The effects of either policy can extend across many later memory transitions. Learning from these effects is difficult because the value of a write, consolidation, or deletion may become clear only in a later task. A final task outcome may not reveal which earlier memory decision was responsible. Verifier-based supervision can provide more local signals during training, but it does not by itself establish the long-term value of an operation Sun et al. [2026] . Storage, latency, and computation costs must also be weighed against future benefits. Repeated adaptation can erode previously useful capabilities, which makes short-term gains an insufficient guide to future updates Yu et al. [2026a] . The objective is therefore to improve memory management without repeatedly sacrificing evidence or capabilities that remain useful.
paragraphs.zh: 当记忆管理规则发生变化时，稳定性—可塑性权衡同样适用于控制未来学习的过程。 过于激进的政策可能反复覆盖有用的证据，而过于保守的政策可能拒绝适应所需的经验。 任一政策的影响都可能延续到后续许多次记忆转换中。 从这些影响中学习很困难，因为一次写入、巩固或删除的价值可能要到之后的任务中才会显现。 最终任务的结果可能无法揭示是哪个较早的记忆决策起了作用。 基于验证器的监督可以在训练过程中提供更局部的信号，但它本身并不能确立某个操作的长期价值 Sun et al. [2026]。 存储成本、延迟和计算开销也必须与未来收益相权衡。 反复的适应可能侵蚀先前有用的能力，这使得短期收益不足以指导未来的更新 Yu et al. [2026a]。 因此，目标是在不反复牺牲仍然有用的证据或能力的前提下改进记忆管理。

paragraphs.en: The landscape shows overlapping design priorities rather than a single path of development. Generative Agents and MemoryBank emphasize reflection, summarization, and the selective reuse of past experience Park et al. [2023] , Zhong et al. [2024] . RecMem and LycheeMemory V2 make the timing and unit of consolidation explicit through semantic recurrence and segment boundaries Dai et al. [2026] , Li et al. [2026a] . SEEM, Zep (Graphiti), and A-MEM organize evolving memory through event fusion and provenance, temporal fact management, and note linking and updates, respectively Lu et al. [2026] , Rasmussen et al. [2025] , Xu et al. [2025] . MemGPT and Mem0 place selected decisions about memory tiers or records under runtime deliberation Packer et al. [2023] , Chhikara et al. [2025] . AgeMem, UMA, and MemRL train memory decisions or retrieval utilities against downstream objectives Yu et al. [2026b] , Zhang et al. [2026e] , Zhang et al. [2026g] . These emphases concern different parts of the learning process and can coexist within a single system.

paragraphs.en: Two points guide the interpretation of this comparison. First, lifecycle operation and control type are distinct design choices. LycheeMemory V2, for example, combines prescribed segment-boundary rules with LLM-planned retrieval Li et al. [2026a] . A mechanism can respond to changing inputs without its decision rule being learned from outcomes. Second, similarly named operations may address different problems. Compressing active context manages a short-term resource limit; the consolidation discussed in Section 3.2 organizes or transforms experience for persistent reuse. Likewise, providing a Delete operation permits removal but does not establish that the system chooses what to forget appropriately. The figure should therefore be read as a map of design choices, not a count of solved learning problems. The central challenge is to coordinate these choices so that consolidation preserves evidence needed for later use and maintenance reduces outdated influence without damaging valid knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 有两点有助于解读这一比较。 首先，生命周期操作与控制类型是不同的设计选择。 例如，LycheeMemory V2 将规定的分段边界规则与由大语言模型规划的检索相结合 Li et al. [2026a]。 一种机制可以在不从结果中学习其决策规则的情况下响应不断变化的输入。 其次，名称相似的操作可能解决的是不同的问题。 压缩活跃上下文管理的是短期资源限制；而 3.2 节讨论的巩固则是对经验进行组织或转换以实现持久复用。 同样，提供删除操作只允许移除内容，并不能证明系统会恰当地选择要遗忘什么。 因此，该图应被解读为设计选择的地图，而不是已解决学习问题的计数。 核心挑战在于协调这些选择，使巩固保留后续使用所需的证据，并使维护在不损害有效知识的前提下减少过时影响。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, the lifecycle explains how experience can change persistent memory, how retrieval and utilization connect that memory to behavior, and how revision and forgetting maintain it as evidence changes. Feedback may also change the policies controlling these operations. Neither a memory update nor a policy update, however, is sufficient evidence of successful continual learning. The next section examines their behavioral consequences, asking whether experience produces durable improvement, appropriate adaptation, and transfer while preserving still-useful capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，该生命周期解释了经验如何改变持久记忆，检索与利用如何将该记忆与行为联系起来，以及修订与遗忘如何在证据变化时维护该记忆。 反馈也可能改变控制这些操作的策略。 然而，无论是记忆更新还是策略更新，都不足以作为成功持续学习的证据。 下一节将考察这些行为后果，追问经验是否能带来持久的改进、恰当的适应与迁移，同时保留仍然有用的能力。

paragraphs.en: Sections 2 and 3 specify how experience can persist, what reusable form it can take, and how it is admitted, consolidated, used, revised, and governed. Those design choices do not, by themselves, establish that continual learning has occurred. A changed store, a retrieved record, or a higher single-task score can all arise without a durable, experience-induced change in later behavior. This section therefore treats evaluation as an evidentiary problem, asking what empirical observations would justify a continual-learning claim given the architecture and lifecycle established in prior sections. We first specify three core behavioral outcomes (retention, adaptation, and transfer) and then establish the protocols needed to measure them without confounding memory with expanded context windows, extra test-time computation, or transient, isolated success.
paragraphs.zh: 第2节和第3节规定了经验如何持久化、它可以采取何种可复用的形式，以及它如何被接纳、巩固、使用、修订和管理。 这些设计选择本身并不能确立持续学习已经发生。 存储发生变化、检索到某条记录，或单任务分数提高，这些都可能在后续行为中并未产生持久的、由经验引起的变化的情况下出现。 因此，本节将评估视为一个证据问题，探究在前几节确立的架构和生命周期的基础上，哪些经验观察才能支撑一个持续学习的主张。 我们首先规定三种核心行为结果（保留、适应和迁移），然后建立测量这些结果所需的协议，以免将记忆与扩展的上下文窗口、额外的测试时计算或瞬时的、孤立的成功相混淆。

paragraphs.en: Access-level metrics remain useful, but they answer a narrower question than learning. Content correctness and retrieval scores diagnose whether experience was written and can still be found; a single-task outcome shows only that memory helped on the current probe (Table 1 ). Continual learning additionally requires that an experiential gain persist under delay and interference, remain revisable when the world changes, and transfer beyond remembered episodes Lopez-Paz and Ranzato [2017] , Wang et al. [2024c] . The remainder of this subsection operationalizes those three outcomes. Component traces localize failure; they do not substitute for the behavioral claim.

paragraphs.en: Section 3.3 distinguishes preservation, access, utilization, and behavioral effect in the memory lifecycle. Retention evaluation uses the same cascade, but changes the object of measurement from a stored trace to a capability margin. After delay and subsequent experience, the agent should still outperform a matched agent deprived of that experience on the same probe. An entry can remain in a store, or a latent state can remain decodable, while its contribution to later decisions has vanished. Conversely, a useful procedure may persist without the originating episode. Trace survival is therefore diagnostic; behavioral persistence is the learning claim.
paragraphs.zh: 第 3.3 节区分了记忆生命周期中的保存、存取、使用和行为效应。 保持评估使用相同的级联结构，但将测量对象从存储的痕迹改变为能力余量。 在经历延迟和后续经验之后，智能体在相同探测任务上仍应优于缺乏该经验的匹配智能体。 一条条目可以保留在存储中，或一个潜在状态仍可被解码，而它对后续决策的贡献已经消失。 反之，一个有用的程序可能在源事件消失后仍然保留。 因此，痕迹存续是诊断性的；行为持续才是学习主张。

paragraphs.en: The four gates yield a testable weakest-gate hypothesis , positing that behavioral retention is bottlenecked by the least reliable step and that improving an earlier gate does not necessarily raise the final outcome. Increasing capacity can raise preservation while lowering access through denser retrieval competition. “The system remembers x x ” concerns preservation and access; “the system retained learning from x x ” additionally requires utilization and effect. With the base model fixed, continual insertion and eviction in an external store can reduce performance on earlier tasks Yu et al. [2026a] , and repeated extraction and injection of experience can turn a single-round gain into progressive collapse Chen et al. [2026a] . These failures are not confined to catastrophic forgetting in weights, as stored content can survive while remaining unaccessed, unused, or ineffective.
paragraphs.zh: 四道门引出一个可检验的「最弱门」假设，即行为的保持受制于最不可靠的环节，并且提升较早的门并不一定会提高最终结果。 增加容量可以在提高保存的同时，因更密集的检索竞争而降低提取。「系统记住了 x x」涉及保存和提取；「系统保留了从 x x 学到的内容」还需要利用和效果。 在基座模型固定的情况下，外部存储中的持续插入与逐出可能降低模型在较早任务上的表现 Yu et al. [2026a]，而反复提取和注入经验可能把单轮的收益变成渐进式崩溃 Chen et al. [2026a]。 这些失败并不局限于权重中的灾难性遗忘，因为存储的内容可能在未被提取、未被使用或无效的情况下依然存留。

paragraphs.en: Time and intervening experience are not interchangeable. A retention protocol should first measure the immediate gain Δ i 0 \Delta_{i}^{0} on capability i i relative to a memoryless or reset condition, then remeasure after delay d d and interference load m m . The normalized retained gain Δ i ​ ( d , m ) / Δ i 0 \Delta_{i}(d,m)/\Delta_{i}^{0} , reported only when Δ i 0 > 0 \Delta_{i}^{0}>0 , distinguishes failure to retain from failure to learn. Delay should be specified in wall-clock time, turns, or token distance; interference should report the number, semantic overlap, and conflict relation of intervening updates. Substrate-specific traces then localize the broken gate, identifying deletion, eviction, and rank competition in external memory, or overwriting, state drift, and readout mismatch in activation and parametric memory (Section 2.1 ). These outcomes are the quantities against which capacity, interference, and cost are traded in Section 4.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 时间与 intervening experience 不可互换。 保持协议应先测量能力 i i 相对于无记忆或重置条件的即时增益 Δ i 0 \Delta_{i}^{0}，然后在延迟 d d 与干扰负载 m m 之后重新测量。 归一化保持增益 Δ i ​ ( d , m ) / Δ i 0 \Delta_{i}(d,m)/\Delta_{i}^{0}（仅在 Δ i 0 > 0 \Delta_{i}^{0}>0 时报告）可区分“未能保持”与“未能学习”。 延迟应以真实时间、轮次或 token 距离来指定；干扰应报告 intervening updates 的数量、语义重叠度及冲突关系。 随后，特定于基底的痕迹可定位失效的门控，识别外部存储中的删除、驱逐与排名竞争，或激活记忆与参数记忆中的覆写、状态漂移与读取不匹配（第 2.1 节）。 这些结果即是第 4.3 节中容量、干扰与成本进行权衡所依据的量。

paragraphs.en: When facts, preferences, tools, or rules change, retention without revision becomes a source of error. Section 3.4 already treats conflict resolution, persistent update, and selective forgetting as lifecycle operations. Evaluation asks a more targeted question, examining whether behavior faithfully follows a valid update after an environment change without indiscriminate damage to still-useful capabilities. The relevant evaluation chain is temporal rather than a single write (detection, revision, recovery, and preservation), which should be quantified via detection delay, steps to recovery, stale-error duration, and collateral degradation on unchanged probes. Better recall does not automatically yield more preference-aligned behavior Xiao et al. [2026] , and summary memories can retain factual detail while losing the preference signal needed after an environmental shift Wang et al. [2026a] .
paragraphs.zh: 当事实、偏好、工具或规则发生变化时，不加以修订的记忆保留就会成为错误的来源。 第 3.4 节已经将冲突解决、持久更新和选择性遗忘视为生命周期操作。 评估提出的是一个更有针对性的问题，即考察在环境变化后，行为是否忠实地遵循一次有效的更新，同时不对仍然有用的能力造成不加区分的损害。 相关的评估链条是时间性的而非单次写入（检测、修订、恢复和保留），应通过检测延迟、恢复所需步数、过时错误的持续时间和在未变探针上的附带退化来加以量化。 更好的召回并不自动产生更符合偏好的行为，Xiao 等人 [2026]，而摘要记忆在保留事实细节的同时，可能丢失环境变化后所需的偏好信号，Wang 等人 [2026a]。

paragraphs.en: Component diagnostics should follow the substrate. For external stores, the question is whether the current record supersedes the stale one and whether retrieval ranks it above obsolete evidence. Exposed maintenance operations establish that updates are possible, but conversational QA after a long history does not demonstrate recovery under controlled drift Chhikara et al. [2025] . For parametric and latent memories, injection accuracy and sequential fact updates are retention and write diagnostics, not evidence that an acting agent detected an unannounced change or resumed correct tool use Wang et al. [2024e] , Das et al. [2024] . Evaluated models can verbalize that a fact has changed yet fail to propagate that judgment to the final prediction Wallat et al. [2026] . A credible adaptation claim therefore requires matched pre-change and post-change probes, together with simultaneous reporting of recovery and selective preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 组件诊断应遵循基底（substrate）来进行。 对于外部存储，问题在于当前记录是否会取代过期记录，以及检索是否会将其排在过时证据之上。 暴露的维护操作表明更新是可能的，但经过漫长历史之后的对话式问答并不能证明在受控漂移下的恢复能力 Chhikara et al. [2025] 。 对于参数化记忆与潜在记忆，注入准确率和顺序事实更新属于保留与写入诊断，并不能证明一个行动中的智能体检测到了未被宣告的变化或恢复了正确的工具使用 Wang et al. [2024e] , Das et al. [2024] 。 被评估的模型能够口头说出某个事实已经改变，却无法将这一判断传递到最终预测 Wallat et al. [2026] 。 因此，一个可信的适应能力主张需要匹配变更前与变更后的探针，并同时报告恢复情况与选择性保留情况。

paragraphs.en: Section 2 classifies reusable experience as episodic, semantic, or procedural assets. Transfer evaluation asks whether those assets support later behavior beyond storing an answer. Three increasingly demanding cases should be separated: replaying the same or a near-duplicate episode, solving an unseen variant from the same task family, and applying shared structure to a distinct target task. Source and target partitions must exclude duplicate instances and target answers, document the shared structure, such as a workflow, causal rule, tool convention, or subskill, while keeping the base model, tools, context budget, and compute matched. Otherwise nearest-neighbour reproduction and extra context can be mistaken for learned transfer.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 节将可复用经验分类为情景性、语义性或程序性资产。 迁移评估要追问的是，这些资产是否能在仅存储答案之外支持后续行为。 应区分三种要求递增的情形：重放相同或近似重复的情节、求解同一任务家族中未见过的变体，以及将共享结构应用到不同的目标任务。 源划分与目标划分必须排除重复实例和目标答案，并记录共享结构（例如工作流、因果规则、工具约定或子技能），同时保持基础模型、工具、上下文预算和算力一致。 否则，最近邻复现和额外上下文可能被误认为习得的迁移。

paragraphs.en: Abstraction directly supports reuse, as demonstrated by the successful transfer of insights, workflows, and executable skills across related tasks and environments Zhao et al. [2024a] , Wang et al. [2025c] , Wang et al. [2024b] . The same evidence shows why mean target accuracy is insufficient. Raw trajectory memory can produce negative forward transfer where abstract insights do not, with harm concentrated on cases that a no-memory agent could not already solve Hu et al. [2026a] . Dedicated memory and skill-maintenance methods are only selectively helpful and can be matched or outperformed by ordinary in-context accumulation Asawa et al. [2026] , Guan et al. [2026] , Zhong et al. [2026] . Transfer should therefore be reported as zero-shot target gain or forward transfer, interactions or tokens to a target threshold, and explicit negative-transfer rates Lopez-Paz and Ranzato [2017] , Rodríguez et al. [2018] . For external memory, analysis should identify whether the retrieved asset is a case, rule, workflow, or skill, and whether success depends on answer overlap. For neural memory, it should test whether updated latent or parametric state improves a held-out target without degrading unrelated tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 抽象直接支持复用，这一点已由洞见、工作流和可执行技能在相关任务与环境间的成功迁移所证明 Zhao et al. [2024a], Wang et al. [2025c], Wang et al. [2024b]。 同样的证据也说明了为什么平均目标准确率是不够的。 原始轨迹记忆可能产生负向的前向迁移，而抽象洞见则不会，且这种危害集中于无记忆智能体尚无法解决的案例上 Hu et al. [2026a]。 专门的记忆与技能维护方法只在特定情况下有帮助，并且可能被普通的上下文内积累所匹敌或超越 Asawa et al. [2026], Guan et al. [2026], Zhong et al. [2026]。 因此，迁移应报告为零样本目标增益或前向迁移、达到目标阈值所需的交互次数或 token 数，以及明确的负迁移率 Lopez-Paz and Ranzato [2017], Rodríguez et al. [2018]。 对于外部记忆，分析应识别所检索的资产是案例、规则、工作流还是技能，以及成功是否依赖于答案重叠。 对于神经记忆，应测试更新后的潜在状态或参数化状态能否在改善留出目标的同时不损害无关任务。

sents.en: Abstraction directly supports reuse, as demonstrated by the successful transfer of insights, workflows, and executable skills across related tasks and environments Zhao et al. [2024a] , Wang et al. [2025c] , Wang et al. [2024b] .
sents.zh: 抽象直接支持复用，这一点已由洞见、工作流和可执行技能在相关任务与环境间的成功迁移所证明 Zhao et al. [2024a], Wang et al. [2025c], Wang et al. [2024b]。

sents.en: The same evidence shows why mean target accuracy is insufficient.
sents.zh: 同样的证据也说明了为什么平均目标准确率是不够的。

sents.en: Raw trajectory memory can produce negative forward transfer where abstract insights do not, with harm concentrated on cases that a no-memory agent could not already solve Hu et al. [2026a] .
sents.zh: 原始轨迹记忆可能产生负向的前向迁移，而抽象洞见则不会，且这种危害集中于无记忆智能体尚无法解决的案例上 Hu et al. [2026a]。

sents.en: Dedicated memory and skill-maintenance methods are only selectively helpful and can be matched or outperformed by ordinary in-context accumulation Asawa et al. [2026] , Guan et al. [2026] , Zhong et al. [2026] .
sents.zh: 专门的记忆与技能维护方法只在特定情况下有帮助，并且可能被普通的上下文内积累所匹敌或超越 Asawa et al. [2026], Guan et al. [2026], Zhong et al. [2026]。

sents.en: Transfer should therefore be reported as zero-shot target gain or forward transfer, interactions or tokens to a target threshold, and explicit negative-transfer rates Lopez-Paz and Ranzato [2017] , Rodríguez et al. [2018] .
sents.zh: 因此，迁移应报告为零样本目标增益或前向迁移、达到目标阈值所需的交互次数或 token 数，以及明确的负迁移率 Lopez-Paz and Ranzato [2017], Rodríguez et al. [2018]。

sents.en: For external memory, analysis should identify whether the retrieved asset is a case, rule, workflow, or skill, and whether success depends on answer overlap.
sents.zh: 对于外部记忆，分析应识别所检索的资产是案例、规则、工作流还是技能，以及成功是否依赖于答案重叠。

sents.en: For neural memory, it should test whether updated latent or parametric state improves a held-out target without degrading unrelated tasks.
sents.zh: 对于神经记忆，应测试更新后的潜在状态或参数化状态能否在改善留出目标的同时不损害无关任务。

paragraphs.en: A parallel distinction applies to benchmark design. The presence of “history” does not imply the presence of learnable experience. Many suites pre-supply dialogue logs, profiles, or knowledge bases and then test whether related questions can be answered after the history is given Maharana et al. [2024] , Du et al. [2024] , Wu et al. [2025a] , Zhong et al. [2024] . Such protocols diagnose long-horizon access. They usually cannot decide whether a new capability was formed during evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 一个类似的区分也适用于基准设计。 “历史”的存在并不意味着存在可学习的经验。 许多测试套件预先提供对话日志、用户画像或知识库，然后测试在给出历史之后能否回答相关问题 Maharana et al. [2024]、Du et al. [2024]、Wu et al. [2025a]、Zhong et al. [2024]。 这类协议诊断的是长程访问能力。 它们通常无法判断在评估过程中是否形成了新的能力。

paragraphs.en: Evidence strength rises with the experience that the protocol actually exposes (Table 2 ). Fixed history supports “remember and use.” Continual writing of state supports “internal state accumulates.” Feedback that improves later behavior, under the matched and sequential controls below, approaches continual learning. Procedural streams ask whether success and failure trajectories improve later workflows Zheng et al. [2025] ; semantic and personalization streams ask whether facts and preferences persist and can be revised Maharana et al. [2024] , Wu et al. [2025a] , Tan et al. [2025a] ; dynamic-rule streams ask whether invalidated experience is corrected in time Hu et al. [2026b] , Asawa et al. [2026] . A benchmark may excel on one stream while remaining silent on the others. Externally grounded outcomes and user corrections also support stronger learning claims than self-generated reflections, which can be stored and later retrieved as if they were facts Shinn et al. [2023] , Park et al. [2023] .

paragraphs.en: Δ ​ P t \Delta P_{t} is not a new composite metric. It denotes the additional benefit associated with accumulated state under otherwise matched conditions Tan et al. [2025a] , Hu et al. [2026b] , Wei et al. [2025] .
paragraphs.zh: ΔPₜ并不是一个新的复合指标。 它表示在其他条件相同的情况下，与累积状态相关的额外收益 Tan et al. [2025a]、Hu et al. [2026b]、Wei et al. [2025]。

paragraphs.en: Further baselines rule out further alternatives. A no-memory or reset condition shows what the model can already do. A full-history context baseline tests whether the benefit is simply more historical text; when a memory mechanism outperforms a matched long-context condition, the evidence favors organization or selective use rather than context expansion alone Wang et al. [2026d] , Tan et al. [2025a] . A static RAG baseline tests whether dynamic accumulation adds anything beyond a fixed knowledge source. Matched computation addresses extra inference. Fine-tuning, LoRA, and model editing absorb experience through different substrates and should not be treated as interchangeable with all forms of agent memory, though they remain useful comparison points.
paragraphs.zh: 进一步的基线实验可以排除更多的其他可能性。 无记忆或重置条件可以展示模型当前已具备的能力。 全历史上下文基线用于检验其收益是否仅仅来自更多的历史文本；当某种记忆机制优于匹配的长上下文条件时，证据更支持的是组织或选择性使用，而非单纯的上下文扩展 Wang et al. [2026d] , Tan et al. [2025a] 。 静态 RAG 基线用于检验动态累积相对于固定知识源是否带来额外收益。 匹配的计算量可以回应额外的推理开销。 微调、LoRA 和模型编辑通过不同的载体吸收经验，不应被视为与各种形式的智能体记忆可以互换，尽管它们仍然是有用的对比点。

sents.en: Further baselines rule out further alternatives.
sents.zh: 进一步的基线实验可以排除更多的其他可能性。

sents.en: A no-memory or reset condition shows what the model can already do.
sents.zh: 无记忆或重置条件可以展示模型当前已具备的能力。

sents.en: A full-history context baseline tests whether the benefit is simply more historical text; when a memory mechanism outperforms a matched long-context condition, the evidence favors organization or selective use rather than context expansion alone Wang et al. [2026d] , Tan et al. [2025a] .

sents.zh: 静态 RAG 基线用于检验动态累积相对于固定知识源是否带来额外收益。

sents.en: Matched computation addresses extra inference.
sents.zh: 匹配的计算量可以回应额外的推理开销。

sents.en: Fine-tuning, LoRA, and model editing absorb experience through different substrates and should not be treated as interchangeable with all forms of agent memory, though they remain useful comparison points.
sents.zh: 微调、LoRA 和模型编辑通过不同的载体吸收经验，不应被视为与各种形式的智能体记忆可以互换，尽管它们仍然是有用的对比点。

paragraphs.en: What “reset” means depends on the substrate (Section 2.1 ). External stores admit write-off, read-off, and clear-store interventions, which separate encoding, use, and overall value. For activation or parametric memory, reset cannot simply mean deleting a database; evaluation must instead distinguish online parameter updates, the preservation of persistent state, and subsequent readout Gutiérrez et al. [2025] . A stateful condition may also bundle conversation history, tool state, and external memory, so a positive Δ ​ P t \Delta P_{t} need not identify which mechanism produced the gain. A stronger design keeps the backbone, task input, context budget, retrieval budget, and inference compute matched while varying only experience-related state.
paragraphs.zh: “重置”的含义取决于底层载体（见 2.1 节）。 外部存储允许写入清除、读取清除和清空存储三种干预方式，从而将编码、使用和总体价值区分开来。 对于激活记忆或参数化记忆，重置不能简单地等同于删除一个数据库；评估必须转而区分在线参数更新、持久状态的保留以及随后的读出 Gutiérrez et al. [2025] 。 有状态条件还可能同时捆绑对话历史、工具状态和外部记忆，因此正向的 Δ ​ P t \Delta P_{t} 未必能指明是哪种机制产生了增益。 更强的实验设计应保持骨干模型、任务输入、上下文预算、检索预算和推理算力一致，仅改变与经验相关的状态。

paragraphs.en: The retention and adaptation definitions above already require the same capability to be measured across memory states. Chronological length does not substitute for that invariance. Endpoint scores after a long history show that information can be used, but not when the benefit appeared or whether it disappeared and recovered Maharana et al. [2024] , Wu et al. [2025a] . A short protocol that probes a capability before acquisition, immediately afterward, and after a controlled update is stronger evidence than a long trajectory with a single terminal score.
paragraphs.zh: 上述保持性与适应性的定义已经要求在多个记忆状态下测量同一能力。 时间上的长度不能替代这种不变性。 长历史之后的终点分数只能表明信息被使用了，但无法表明收益何时出现、是否消失后又恢复 Maharana et al. [2024]，Wu et al. [2025a]。 一个在能力获得之前、获得之后以及受控更新之后探测该能力的简短协议，比只有单个终点分数的长轨迹是更强的证据。

sents.zh: 上述保持性与适应性的定义已经要求在多个记忆状态下测量同一能力。

sents.zh: 一个在能力获得之前、获得之后以及受控更新之后探测该能力的简短协议，比只有单个终点分数的长轨迹是更强的证据。

paragraphs.en: Four observation regimes support progressively stronger claims. Snapshots test a final memory state; streams report online reward on changing tasks; reprobes repeat the same capability or a calibrated task variant; and interventional panels combine reprobes with an event ledger and matched stateful–reset trajectories. AgentCL and CL-Bench illustrate the value of a stable observation target, where first-pass, frozen-memory, and held-out probes systematically isolate acquisition, reuse, and transfer Shu et al. [2026] , Asawa et al. [2026] . Between probes, the ledger should record elapsed time, writes, semantic overlap, conflicts, feedback, tool or rule changes, and retrieval or update cost. Delay plus overlapping updates tests retention; changes in facts, preferences, or tools test adaptation; held-out tasks that preserve latent structure test transfer. Evidence for one evaluation setting should not be treated as validation across all three.
paragraphs.zh: 四种观测机制支持强度递增的结论。 快照测试最终的记忆状态；流式评估在变化的任务上报告在线奖励；重探测重复同一能力或经过校准的任务变体；而干预式面板则将重探测与事件台账以及匹配的有状态—重置轨迹相结合。 AgentCL 和 CL-Bench 展示了稳定观测目标的价值，其中首轮、冻结记忆和留出探测系统地分离了获取、复用与迁移 Shu et al. [2026]、Asawa et al. [2026]。 在各次探测之间，台账应记录经过的时间、写入、语义重叠、冲突、反馈、工具或规则变更，以及检索或更新成本。 延迟加重叠更新测试保持能力；事实、偏好或工具的变化测试适应能力；保留潜在结构的留出任务测试迁移能力。 某一评估设定下的证据不应被视为对所有三种设定的验证。

sents.en: Four observation regimes support progressively stronger claims.
sents.zh: 四种观测机制支持强度递增的结论。

sents.en: Snapshots test a final memory state; streams report online reward on changing tasks; reprobes repeat the same capability or a calibrated task variant; and interventional panels combine reprobes with an event ledger and matched stateful–reset trajectories.
sents.zh: 快照测试最终的记忆状态；流式评估在变化的任务上报告在线奖励；重探测重复同一能力或经过校准的任务变体；而干预式面板则将重探测与事件台账以及匹配的有状态—重置轨迹相结合。

paragraphs.en: A compact blueprint follows. Define capability anchors and measure them before and immediately after acquisition; schedule checkpoints on a declared delay–interference grid; run stateful and reset conditions with identical backbone, tools, context, retrieval, and inference budgets; and populate a matrix R t , i R_{t,i} that re-evaluates capability i i after update t t . Diagonal entries measure acquisition, lower-triangular entries expose retention and backward influence, and held-out variants test transfer. Reporting the event ledger beside this matrix prevents apparent gains from obscuring task drift or hidden computational overhead.
paragraphs.zh: 下面是一份简明的蓝图。 定义能力锚点，并在获取前后立即对其进行测量；在预先声明的延迟—干扰网格上安排检查点；在主干、工具、上下文、检索与推理预算完全相同的条件下，运行有状态与重置两种设定；并填充矩阵 R t , i R_{t,i}，该矩阵在每次更新 t t 之后重新评估能力 i i。 对角线元素衡量获取效果，下三角元素揭示保留情况与反向影响，而留出变体则用于检验迁移。 在该矩阵旁报告事件台账，可防止表面上的收益掩盖任务漂移或隐藏的计算开销。

paragraphs.en: Existing suites occupy different cells of this design rather than a common scale. Access-oriented histories, incremental ingestion, and sequential interactive tasks are not interchangeable measurements of the same construct, and they rarely match context budgets, retrieval depth, or inference compute. Numerical comparison across papers is therefore unreliable unless the protocol specifies the behavioral outcome in Section 4.1 , the experience regime above, and the matched and sequential controls that isolate memory. Scores should be read within that evidentiary scope, not as a generic ranking of memory systems.
paragraphs.zh: 现有测试套件占据的是这一设计空间中不同的单元格，而非同一尺度上的不同位置。 面向访问的历史记录、增量式数据摄取以及顺序式交互任务，并非对同一构念的可互换度量，而且它们很少与上下文预算、检索深度或推理算力相匹配。 因此，跨论文的数值比较是不可靠的，除非该协议明确了第 4.1 节中的行为结果、上述经验机制，以及用于隔离记忆作用的匹配控制与顺序控制。 各项分数应在其证据范围内解读，而不能被视作对记忆系统的通用排名。

paragraphs.en: We propose a Memory Scaling Law relating attainable performance to experience, persistent capacity, and read–write compute. Its central prediction is a sequence of resource-limited regimes, where performance improves as relevant experience accumulates and subsequently saturates when capacity or read–write compute constrains its effective use. Expanding the limiting resources shifts these saturation points. The information structure of experience determines how quickly capacity demand grows, while reuse determines how much computation is worth investing in writing and consolidation. This view connects memory representations and lifecycle operations to the rate and cost of capability growth during deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一条记忆缩放定律，将可达到的性能与经验、持久容量以及读写计算关联起来。 其核心预测是一系列资源受限的状态：随着相关经验的积累，性能会不断提升，随后当容量或读写计算限制了经验的有效利用时，性能趋于饱和。 扩展受限资源会使这些饱和点发生移动。 经验的信息结构决定了容量需求增长的速度，而复用则决定了在写入与巩固上值得投入多少计算。 这一视角将记忆表征与生命周期操作同部署过程中能力增长的速度和成本联系起来。

paragraphs.en: A capacity-only sweep can plateau because reading, experience supply, or maintenance becomes limiting. paragraphs.en: The frontier is specific to the policy class: admitting more efficient representations or access mechanisms can change its shape and its optimal allocation. Foundation-model capabilities also condition the returns. Pretrained knowledge reduces some storage requirements, while the ability to interpret abstractions and combine evidence increases the value of a given memory bank. Recent facts and private interactions have to be acquired during deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 前沿边界因策略类别而异：允许更高效的表示或访问机制会改变其形状及其最优分配。 基础模型的能力也决定着回报。 预训练知识降低了某些存储需求，而解释抽象和组合证据的能力则提升了给定记忆库的价值。 最新事实和私有交互则必须在部署期间获取。

paragraphs.en: While the additive approximation in Figure 7 predicts that storage and reading co-scale under a shared budget constraint, empirical history-based question answering also exhibits direct interaction because effective readout is bounded by retained storage ( R eff = min ⁡ ( R , B t ) R_{\mathrm{eff}}=\min(R,B_{t}) ) and retrieval competition (Figure 8 (a–c)). On LoCoMo Maharana et al. [2024] , increasing the read budget from 512 to 2,048 tokens improves Raw RAG F1 by 0.89 percentage points at one-eighth history retention and 3.82 points at full retention. The paired difference between these gains is 2.93 points ( 95 % 95\% interval: [ 2.06 , 4.02 ] [2.06,4.02] ). On the selected LongMemEval Wu et al. [2025a] samples, full-history Raw RAG accuracy increases from 35.00% to 44.00% over the same read-budget change. These observations confirm storage–reading complementarity: the return from additional reading depends on the available memory.

paragraphs.en: Consolidation changes this relationship by turning repeated detail into reusable structure. ReasoningBank converts successes and failures into reasoning strategies Ouyang et al. [2026] . Experience Scaling merges and refines experience to reduce redundancy, while finding that excessive compression can harm performance Yin et al. [2025] . Abstractions can support multiple tasks, while exceptions and rare queries may need the original details. Episodic, semantic, and procedural assets thus have different fidelity and capacity requirements. Under environmental change, the rate of revision also determines how quickly useful performance can recover (Figure 9 (c)).
paragraphs.zh: 固化通过将重复的细节转化为可复用的结构，改变了这种关系。 ReasoningBank 将成功与失败转化为推理策略 Ouyang et al. [2026]。 Experience Scaling 通过合并与精炼经验来减少冗余，同时发现过度压缩可能会损害性能 Yin et al. [2025]。 抽象可以支持多个任务，而例外情况和罕见查询可能需要原始细节。 因此，情景性、语义性和程序性资产具有不同的保真度与容量需求。 在环境变化下，修订的速度也决定了有用性能能够多快恢复（图 9 (c)）。

paragraphs.en: At equal performance, lightweight writing and direct reading may cost less when reuse is limited. More expensive preparation becomes worthwhile when cumulative query savings exceed its additional cost. For fixed-quality policies with no ongoing maintenance, the crossover reuse count is the extra construction cost divided by the per-query saving.

paragraphs.en: Token savings and latency savings can differ. On the matched LoCoMo small-bank cohort (Table 4 ), query-time summarization reduces serialized memory input but increases latency. paragraphs.en: Environmental change bounds how many times a memory can be reused before it needs revision. Retention extends the period over which preparation costs can be amortized, and transfer increases the number of tasks served by the same experience. Adaptation incurs the maintenance cost required to keep that experience useful. These continual-learning properties determine the reuse horizon and update costs in the resource-optimal allocation of Equation ( 4.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 环境变化限定了一段记忆在被修改之前能够被复用的次数。 保留延长了准备成本可以摊销的时间跨度，而迁移则增加了同一段经验所能服务的任务数量。 适应则产生维持该经验持续有效所需的维护成本。 这些持续学习的特性决定了公式（4.4）中资源最优分配的复用期限与更新成本。

paragraphs.en: Parametric memory writes deployment experience into model parameters or persistent neural states rather than into an external store. Representative designs include trainable memory layers Berges et al. [2025] , plug-and-play memory modules Cao et al. [2025] , memory states updated at test time Behrouz et al. [2025] , Kuratov et al. [2026] , side memories isolated from the backbone Wang et al. [2024d] , Das et al. [2024] , Wang et al. [2024e] , and direct editing or fine-tuning of backbone weights Meng et al. [2023] , Xu et al. [2026b] . These approaches confront the same fundamental question as non-parametric memory regarding how performance scales with experience and resources, and at what write and compute cost. They differ in one essential respect. All writes share the same parameters, so new writes alter how earlier content is read out. Accumulating experience therefore adds usable content while simultaneously increasing the probability that existing content is overwritten. We build this property into the scaling relation and propose a parametric counterpart to Equation ( 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 参数化记忆将部署经验写入模型参数或持久神经状态，而不是写入外部存储。 代表性设计包括可训练记忆层 Berges et al. [2025]、即插即用记忆模块 Cao et al. [2025]、在测试时更新的记忆状态 Behrouz et al. [2025]、Kuratov et al. [2026]、与主干隔离的旁路记忆 Wang et al. [2024d]、Das et al. [2024]、Wang et al. [2024e]，以及对主干权重的直接编辑或微调 Meng et al. [2023]、Xu et al. [2026b]。 这些方法与非参数化记忆面临着相同的基本问题：性能如何随经验和资源扩展，以及写入和计算成本是多少。 它们在一个本质方面有所不同。 所有写入共享同一组参数，因此新的写入会改变先前内容被读取的方式。 因此，经验的积累在增加可用内容的同时，也提高了既有内容被覆写的概率。 我们将这一性质纳入扩展关系，并提出式 ( 4.2 ) 的参数化对应形式。

paragraphs.en: We retain the notation of Section 4.3.1 , where E t E_{t} denotes cumulative experience, θ \theta denotes the foundation model, and 𝒟 \mathcal{D} denotes the task distribution. Parametric memory involves three resources. Memory capacity M M is the number of memory parameters, memory slots, adapter rank, or persistent-state dimensions, playing the role of B ¯ \bar{B} . The write budget U U represents the computation used to write experience into parameters, such as gradient steps, update steps per write, and write frequency. Readout compute is fixed by the architecture, as each forward pass traverses the memory parameters or performs a fixed top- k k lookup without consuming additional prompt context tokens; consequently, the read budget R R is generally not an independent decision variable. This marks the first major divergence from non-parametric memory.

paragraphs.en: The first term mirrors Equation ( 4.2 ), approximating the residual loss from resource shortages where the largest component identifies the active bottleneck. The second term is an interference term specific to parametric memory. It is close to zero while the load ratio stays below a critical value ρ s , π ⋆ \rho^{\star}_{s,\pi} ; beyond that value, new writes begin to overwrite earlier content and loss rises. The critical ratio depends on the memory substrate s s (Section 2.1 ) and on the write policy π \pi . In non-parametric memory, additional experience can crowd retrieval or trigger eviction while leaving surviving records intact, a cost mediated by the read and maintenance terms. In parametric memory, additional experience rewrites shared parameters directly, so performance degradation as experience grows is an intrinsic property of the substrate rather than only a retrieval or selection problem.
paragraphs.zh: 第一项与式（4.2）一致，近似资源短缺导致的残余损失，其中最大的分量标识出活跃的瓶颈。 第二项是参数化记忆特有的干扰项。 当负载比低于临界值 ρ s , π ⋆ \rho^{\star}_{s,\pi} 时，该项接近于零；一旦超过该值，新的写入开始覆盖较早的内容，损失随之上升。 临界比取决于记忆基质 s s（见 2.1 节）以及写入策略 π \pi。 在非参数化记忆中，新增经验可能挤占检索空间或触发驱逐，同时保持存留记录完好，其代价由读取项和维护项共同调节。 在参数化记忆中，新增经验会直接改写共享参数，因此性能随经验增长而退化是基质本身的内在属性，而不仅仅是检索或选择的问题。

paragraphs.en: Equation ( 4.8 ) yields three testable predictions. First, when experience and write budget are fixed and only capacity grows, loss is initially dominated by interference and follows the power law only after the load ratio enters the safe regime (Figure 11 (a)). Second, when capacity is fixed and experience grows, loss rises once the load ratio crosses ρ ⋆ \rho^{\star} , and the transition can differ by orders of magnitude across substrates (Figure 11 (b)). Third, load curves measured at several capacities should approximately collapse onto a single curve when plotted against ρ \rho . This collapse is the most direct test of whether interference depends on load only through the ratio.

paragraphs.en: Experiments that hold the foundation model fixed and enlarge only the memory parameters support the shape of the capacity term. Memory Layers at Scale enlarges the Memory+ value count from 1M to 64M in a 1.3B configuration (Figure 12 (a)) Berges et al. [2025] . NaturalQuestions accuracy rises from 13.68 to 20.78 and TriviaQA F1 from 42.89 to 62.14, well above a dense model of the same configuration without memory layers (7.76 and 32.64). Between 16M and 64M, however, NaturalQuestions improves by only 0.64 while TriviaQA still improves by 3.47, indicating that the same capacity range places different tasks at different points on the power law. The same work scales memory parameters to 128B on foundation models of at most 8B, showing that memory capacity can far exceed backbone size (though these Memory+ layers are trained jointly during pretraining, so sequential deployment writes remain to be tested separately).
paragraphs.zh: 在保持基础模型固定、仅扩大记忆参数的实验中，容量项的形态得到了支持。 Memory Layers at Scale 在 1.3B 配置中将 Memory+ 的取值数量从 100 万扩大到 6400 万（图 12 (a)）Berges et al. [2025]。 NaturalQuestions 准确率从 13.68 提升到 20.78，TriviaQA F1 从 42.89 提升到 62.14，远高于同配置且不含记忆层的稠密模型（7.76 和 32.64）。 然而在 1600 万到 6400 万之间，NaturalQuestions 仅提升了 0.64，而 TriviaQA 仍提升了 3.47，这表明相同的容量范围使不同任务处于幂律上的不同位置。 同一工作在至多 8B 的基础模型上将记忆参数扩展到 128B，表明记忆容量可以远超主干网络的规模（不过这些 Memory+ 层是在预训练期间联合训练的，因此顺序部署写入仍有待单独验证）。

paragraphs.en: Direct functional evidence comes from LoRA memorization. Treating LoRA rank r r as a capacity probe, a recent study reports a power law Δ ​ ℒ = C ​ r α ​ ℓ − β + b \Delta\mathcal{L}=C\,r^{\alpha}\ell^{-\beta}+b that links the loss reduction to rank and sequence length ℓ \ell across models, datasets, and semantic densities ( R 2 > 0.98 R^{2}>0.98 ) Xu et al. [2026b] . The relation contains both a capacity variable and a load variable. If α ≈ β \alpha\approx\beta , it reduces to a function of r / ℓ r/\ell , the dependence on the load ratio that Equation ( 4.8 ) predicts; whether the two exponents coincide is therefore a direct test of the proposed form. The same study shows that capacity alone does not determine what is stored. At equal rank on Qwen3-8B, memorization accuracy differs sharply across write methods (Figure 12 (b)), where at rank 128, SFT reaches 40.0 % 40.0\% , MemFT-OT reaches 100.0 % 100.0\% , and MemFT-SW reaches 94.4 % 94.4\% . In the terms of Equation ( 4.8 ), the write method changes a M a_{M} and α M \alpha_{M} , so better methods lie closer to the attainable frontier at the same capacity.
paragraphs.zh: 直接的功能性证据来自 LoRA 的记忆化研究。 将 LoRA 的秩 r r 作为容量探针，一项近期研究报告了幂律关系 Δ ​ ℒ = C ​ r α ​ ℓ − β + b \Delta\mathcal{L}=C\,r^{\alpha}\ell^{-\beta}+b ，该关系将损失下降与秩和序列长度 ℓ \ell 联系起来，并跨模型、数据集和语义密度成立（ R 2 > 0.98 R^{2}>0.98 ）（Xu et al. [2026b]）。 该关系同时包含一个容量变量和一个负载变量。 若 α ≈ β \alpha\approx\beta ，则该式可化简为 r / ℓ r/\ell 的函数，即式（ 4.8 ）所预测的对负载比的依赖；因此两个指数是否重合，是对所提出形式的直接检验。 同一项研究还表明，仅凭容量并不能决定存储的内容是什么。 在 Qwen3-8B 上相同秩的条件下，不同写入方法的记忆化准确率差异显著（图 12 (b)）：在秩为 128 时，SFT 达到 40.0 % 40.0\% ，MemFT-OT 达到 100.0 % 100.0\% ，MemFT-SW 达到 94.4 % 94.4\% 。 用式（ 4.8 ）的术语来说，写入方法改变的是 a M a_{M} 和 α M \alpha_{M} ，因此在相同容量下，更好的方法更接近可达到的前沿。

paragraphs.en: The foundation model also conditions memory returns. Attaching the same 0.5B Memory Decoder to Qwen2.5 models from 0.5B to 72B reduces average domain perplexity by 10.24 at 0.5B but by only 2.39 at 72B, and the 0.5B model with the memory module (4.06) outperforms the 72B model alone (5.85; Figure 13 (a)) Cao et al. [2025] . This mirrors the substitution and complementarity between model and memory discussed in Section 4.3.1 . Continual fine-tuning studies further find that, between 1B and 7B parameters, larger models forget more severely Luo et al. [2025] . The foundation model may therefore shift ρ ⋆ \rho^{\star} as well as ϵ ∞ \epsilon_{\infty} and should be reported as a controlled condition.
paragraphs.zh: 基础模型同样会影响记忆的返回效果。 将同一个 0.5B 的记忆解码器（Memory Decoder）附加到从 0.5B 到 72B 的 Qwen2.5 模型上，在 0.5B 时平均领域困惑度降低 10.24，而在 72B 时仅降低 2.39，且带记忆模块的 0.5B 模型（4.06）优于单独的 72B 模型（5.85；图 13 (a)）Cao et al. [2025]。 这印证了第 4.3.1 节所讨论的模型与记忆之间的替代与互补关系。 持续微调研究进一步发现，在 1B 到 7B 参数之间，更大的模型遗忘得更严重 Luo et al. [2025]。 因此，基础模型可能会改变 ρ ⋆ \rho^{\star} 以及 ϵ ∞ \epsilon_{\infty}，应将其作为一个受控条件加以报告。

paragraphs.en: Figure 12 (d) summarizes the number of updates or evaluated write horizons reported across representative parametric-memory studies. With direct backbone editing, sequential ROME edits degrade performance after roughly 100 to 1,000 edits across typical edit sequences and can even trigger immediate model collapse after certain individual disabling edits Meng et al. [2022] , Gupta et al. [2024] . Sequential MEMIT enters catastrophic forgetting after about 1,400 edits on GPT-J 6B, whereas batch MEMIT on the same model edits 10,000 facts simultaneously in a single batch Gupta et al. [2024] , Meng et al. [2023] . When writes are isolated from the backbone, Larimar sustains 1,000 sequential scope writes (200 facts across 5 rephrasings) Das et al. [2024] , WISE remains effective at 3,000 sequential edits on ZsRE without backbone collapse Wang et al. [2024d] , and MEMORYLLM, with a fixed memory pool of about 1.07B parameters, maintains stable readout of newly injected context across 650,000 sequential context updates under random memory-slot replacement and exponential decay Wang et al. [2024e] . Because MEMORYLLM evaluates retention of recent context under continual slot turnover rather than simultaneous retention of all historical writes, and an update writes a context segment rather than a single fact edit, only coarse orders of magnitude and protocol regimes are comparable. Even so, the gap of roughly one to two orders of magnitude between dedicated modules and sequential backbone editing, and the gap between batch and sequential writes, are consistent with a critical ratio shaped by substrate and policy.
paragraphs.zh: 图12（d）总结了代表性参数化记忆研究中报告的更新次数或已评估的写入视界数量。 在直接编辑主干的情况下，顺序 ROME 编辑在典型编辑序列中大约经过100到1,000次编辑后会导致性能下降，某些单独的禁用编辑甚至可能立即引发模型崩溃 Meng et al. [2022]、Gupta et al. [2024]。 顺序 MEMIT 在 GPT-J 6B 上大约经过1,400次编辑后进入灾难性遗忘，而在同一模型上，批量 MEMIT 可以在单个批次中同时编辑10,000个事实 Gupta et al. [2024]、Meng et al. [2023]。 当写入与主干隔离时，Larimar 能够支持1,000次顺序范围写入（5种改写共200个事实）Das et al. [2024]，WISE 在 ZsRE 上经过3,000次顺序编辑后仍保持有效且主干不崩溃 Wang et al. [2024d]，而 MEMORYLLM 拥有约10.7亿参数的固定记忆池，在随机记忆槽替换和指数衰减机制下，经过650,000次顺序上下文更新后仍能稳定读取新注入的上下文 Wang et al. [2024e]。 由于 MEMORYLLM 评估的是在持续槽位更替下对近期上下文的保留，而非对所有历史写入的同时保留，且每次更新写入的是一个上下文片段而非单个事实编辑，因此只能比较粗略的数量级和协议机制。 即便如此，专用模块与顺序主干编辑之间大约一到两个数量级的差距，以及批量写入与顺序写入之间的差距，都与由载体和策略塑造的临界比率相一致。

paragraphs.en: Write budget can partly substitute for capacity. GradMem fixes the memory at eight vectors and increases the number of key–value pairs to be stored (Figure 12 (c)) Kuratov et al. [2026] . With one write step, exact match falls from 100.0 % 100.0\% at 4 pairs to 32.6 % 32.6\% at 96 pairs; with five write steps, it remains 99.1 % 99.1\% at 64 pairs and 88.4 % 88.4\% at 96 pairs. In Equation ( 4.8 ), the write budget U U moves the critical ratio to the right. This result comes from a synthetic task, and existing studies vary either capacity or load but not both, so the third prediction, collapse of load curves across capacities, remains untested.

paragraphs.en: Writing more often is not always better. TMEM varies how much context accumulates before a parametric write is triggered, where F1 peaks at a 4K-token threshold on LoCoMo (25.72) and at 12K on LongMemEval-S (41.24), and declines at both smaller and larger thresholds (Figure 13 (b–c)) Ren et al. [2026] . A plausible interpretation is that writing too often produces fragmented updates and raises the effective load quickly, whereas writing too rarely forces each update to compress too much context at once. The policy π \pi therefore exhibits a task-dependent favorable range rather than shifting the critical ratio monotonically.
paragraphs.zh: 更频繁地写入并不总是更好。 TMEM 改变了在触发参数化写入之前累积多少上下文，其中 F1 在 LoCoMo 上于 4K token 阈值处达到峰值（25.72），在 LongMemEval-S 上于 12K 处达到峰值（41.24），而在更小和更大的阈值处均有所下降（图 13 (b–c)）Ren et al. [2026]。 一种合理的解释是，写入过于频繁会产生碎片化的更新并迅速提高有效负载，而写入过于稀少则迫使每次更新一次性压缩过多的上下文。 因此，策略 π \pi 呈现出依赖任务的有利区间，而非单调地移动临界比值。

paragraphs.en: Under the cost structure of Equation ( 4.6 ), parametric memory concentrates cost in C build C_{\mathrm{build}} and C maint C_{\mathrm{maint}} , through gradient updates and batch consolidation, while context-token readout overhead in C ¯ query \overline{C}_{\mathrm{query}} is zero because readout happens within the forward pass and consumes no additional prompt context. Its average cost advantage therefore grows with the reuse count N N . Under environmental change, however, parametric memory cannot precisely delete or revise an individual item, and each revision adds to the load, which raises maintenance cost and directly affects adaptation (Section 4.1 ). This suggests a natural division of labor, where rapidly changing experience is retained in external memory, while stable, frequently reused experience is consolidated into parameters, in line with the synergy discussed in Section 6.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 在式（4.6）的成本结构下，参数化记忆将成本集中在 C_{\mathrm{build}} 和 C_{\mathrm{maint}} 中，通过梯度更新与批量巩固实现，而 \overline{C}_{\mathrm{query}} 中的上下文词元读取开销为零，因为读取发生在前向传播内部，不消耗额外的提示上下文。 因此，其平均成本优势随复用次数 N 的增加而增长。 然而在环境变化下，参数化记忆无法精确删除或修改单条条目，每次修改都会增加负载，从而抬高维护成本并直接影响适应性（见4.1节）。 这提示了一种自然的分工方式：快速变化的经验保留在外部记忆中，而稳定且被频繁复用的经验则巩固进参数之中，这与6.3节讨论的协同效应相一致。

paragraphs.en: Parametric and non-parametric memory thus share resource-limited power-law terms and an attainable frontier, but parametric memory differs in three respects: its read budget is fixed by the architecture, its scaling relation contains an interference term governed by the load ratio, and its capacity demand is amplified by the critical ratio. Scaling parametric memory is therefore not only a matter of increasing M M ; isolated writes, batch writes, larger write budgets, and well-chosen write timing are needed to keep ρ \rho below ρ ⋆ \rho^{\star} .
paragraphs.zh: 因此，参数化记忆与非参数化记忆共享受资源限制的幂律项和可达到的前沿，但参数化记忆在三个方面有所不同：其读取预算由架构固定，其缩放关系包含一个由负载比支配的干扰项，并且其容量需求被临界比放大。 因此，扩展参数化记忆不仅仅是增大 M M 的问题；还需要孤立写入、批量写入、更大的写入预算以及恰当选择的写入时机，以使 ρ \rho 保持在 ρ ⋆ \rho^{\star} 以下。

paragraphs.en: When agents deploy over weeks or months, their operational context constantly shifts: user goals change, software interfaces update, and physical surroundings evolve. In these settings, continual learning serves two practical roles: it keeps long-running tasks on track, and it applies past experience to new problems. Memory provides the backbone for both. By storing past interactions, execution outcomes, and environmental states, memory gives agents a stable basis for future decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体在数周或数月的时间跨度内部署运行时，其运行环境会不断变化：用户目标发生改变，软件界面持续更新，物理环境也在演变。 在这些场景下，持续学习发挥着两大实际作用：一是使长期运行的任务保持在正轨上，二是将过往经验应用于新问题。 而记忆为这两者提供了基础支撑。 通过存储过去的交互、执行结果和环境状态，记忆为智能体的未来决策提供了稳定的基础。

sents.zh: 通过存储过去的交互、执行结果和环境状态，记忆为智能体的未来决策提供了稳定的基础。

paragraphs.en: These capabilities take four main forms across digital and physical domains (Figure 14 ): (1) personal agents track evolving user preferences; (2) digital agents turn execution logs into reusable workflows; (3) embodied robots map environments and acquire physical skills; and (4) multi-agent teams share project context and collaboration patterns. Below, we examine how each setting turns accumulated experience into durable capability.
paragraphs.zh: 这些能力在数字与物理领域以四种主要形式呈现（图 14）：（1）个人智能体追踪不断演化的用户偏好；（2）数字智能体将执行日志转化为可复用的工作流；（3）具身机器人映射环境并习得物理技能；（4）多智能体团队共享项目上下文与协作模式。 下面，我们考察每种场景如何将积累的经验转化为持久的能力。

sents.en: Below, we examine how each setting turns accumulated experience into durable capability.
sents.zh: 下面，我们考察每种场景如何将积累的经验转化为持久的能力。

paragraphs.en: Personal agents must adapt as users change. Over time, schedules shift, learners build skills or form misconceptions, health symptoms evolve, and interpersonal bonds deepen. To remain useful, an agent must update its internal model of the user and use this state to guide dialogue, planning, and tool calls.
paragraphs.zh: 个人智能体必须随用户的变化而调整。 随着时间推移，日程会变动，学习者会积累技能或形成误解，健康症状会演变，人际关系也会加深。 为了保持实用性，智能体必须更新其对用户的内部模型，并利用这一状态来指导对话、规划与工具调用。

sents.en: Personal agents must adapt as users change.
sents.zh: 个人智能体必须随用户的变化而调整。

paragraphs.en: Personal assistants. Assistants use cross-session logs to maintain conversational continuity and match individual style. Retrieving user profile items directly improves generation on tasks like email drafting and news summarization [ Salemi et al., 2024 ] , while modeling complete interaction histories captures personal tone and habits [ Liu et al., 2025b ] . Crucially, assistants must track when facts expire. Recent systems update user facts across conversations [ Bae et al., 2022 ] , decay memory strength over time [ Zhong et al., 2024 ] , record user feedback alongside its valid context [ Yuan et al., 2025b ] , and organize changing user states through causal links [ Ong et al., 2025 ] . These mechanisms ensure that assistants preserve core preferences while promptly reflecting new changes.
paragraphs.zh: 个人助理。 助理利用跨会话日志来保持对话的连续性，并匹配个人风格。 直接检索用户画像条目可以改进诸如撰写电子邮件和新闻摘要等任务的生成效果 [ Salemi et al., 2024 ] ，而对完整交互历史进行建模则能捕捉个人的语气和习惯 [ Liu et al., 2025b ] 。 至关重要的是，助理必须追踪事实何时过期。 近期系统会在跨对话时更新用户事实 [ Bae et al., 2022 ] 、随时间衰减记忆强度 [ Zhong et al., 2024 ] 、将用户反馈连同其有效上下文一并记录 [ Yuan et al., 2025b ] ，并通过因果链接来组织不断变化的用户状态 [ Ong et al., 2025 ] 。 这些机制确保助理在保留核心偏好的同时，能够及时反映新的变化。

paragraphs.en: Tutoring agents. Tutoring agents track what a student knows and where they struggle. For example, ScaffoldLM stores pedagogical goals, step-level progress, and inferred misconceptions in an assessment memory, selecting the next hint based on the learner’s latest response [ Li et al., 2026b ] . Similarly, versioned student profiles track skill mastery, error patterns, and review schedules to calibrate hints and spaced practice [ David and Ghosh, 2026 ] . Updating student profiles in real time allows agents to adjust lesson pacing, hint specificity, and problem difficulty on the fly.
paragraphs.zh: 辅导智能体。 辅导智能体会追踪学生已掌握的知识以及他们在哪里遇到困难。 例如，ScaffoldLM 将教学目标、步骤级进度和推断出的误解存储在评估记忆中，并根据学习者的最新回答选择下一个提示 [ Li et al., 2026b ] 。 类似地，带版本的学员画像会追踪技能掌握情况、错误模式以及复习计划，以校准提示和间隔练习 [ David and Ghosh, 2026 ] 。 实时更新学员画像使智能体能够即时调整课程节奏、提示的具体程度和问题难度。

paragraphs.en: Health follow-up and emotional companionship. Memory directly underpins long-term care and companionship. In a ten-week study of 147 real-world users (1,252 calls), the CareCall system used memory to revisit past health complaints and life events. This continuity encouraged users to disclose more health details and build trust [ Jo et al., 2024 ] . Studies on Replika users show that social bonding varies widely in depth and pace, meaning companion agents cannot rely on static facts alone [ Skjuve et al., 2022 , Skjuve et al., 2023 ] . Effective companionship requires referencing shared moments and conversational routines. For instance, recent agents infer implicit emotional needs and retrieve relevant shared memories to offer proactive comfort [ Fu et al., 2026 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 健康随访与情感陪伴。 记忆直接支撑长期照护与陪伴。 在一项针对147名真实用户（共1,252通电话）的十周研究中，CareCall 系统利用记忆回顾过去的健康问题和生活事件。 这种连续性鼓励用户披露更多健康细节并建立信任 [ Jo et al., 2024 ] 。 针对 Replika 用户的研究表明，社交纽带的深度和发展速度差异很大，这意味着陪伴型智能体不能仅依赖静态事实 [ Skjuve et al., 2022 , Skjuve et al., 2023 ] 。 有效的陪伴需要引用共同经历的时刻和对话惯例。 例如，近期的智能体会推断隐含的情感需求，并检索相关的共同记忆以提供主动的安抚 [ Fu et al., 2026 ] 。

paragraphs.en: From personalized generation to tool use. Personalization extends beyond text generation to planning and tool execution. Dual-reflection mechanisms build user memory banks that accurately route past preferences to current prompts [ Tan et al., 2025b ] . In tool-augmented setups, benchmarks like Mem2ActBench test whether agents can translate past dates, locations, and habits into correct API parameters [ Shen et al., 2026 ] . Through memory, personalization becomes a continuous feedback loop: each interaction updates the user model, which in turn steers the agent’s next action.
paragraphs.zh: 从个性化生成到工具使用。 个性化不仅限于文本生成，还延伸到规划与工具执行。 双重反思机制构建用户记忆库，将过往偏好准确地路由到当前提示 [ Tan et al., 2025b ] 。 在工具增强的设置中，像 Mem2ActBench 这样的基准测试会检验智能体能否将过去的日期、地点和习惯转化为正确的 API 参数 [ Shen et al., 2026 ] 。 通过记忆，个性化成为一个持续的反馈循环：每次交互都会更新用户模型，而用户模型又进而引导智能体的下一步行动。

paragraphs.en: Digital tasks often span multiple web pages, applications, and execution steps. Web research requires tracking checked links and active filters; desktop tasks coordinate code editors, terminals, and spreadsheets; and software engineering requires navigating evolving codebases. In these settings, continual learning serves two needs: resuming interrupted workflows and transferring problem-solving strategies across tasks. Memory tracks progress to ensure task continuity, while abstracting successful runs into reusable skills and debugging routines.
paragraphs.zh: 数字化任务常常跨越多个网页、应用程序和执行步骤。 网络研究需要跟踪已查看的链接和生效的筛选条件；桌面任务需要协调代码编辑器、终端和电子表格；软件工程则需要在不断演变的代码库中导航。 在这些场景中，持续学习满足两种需求：恢复被中断的工作流程，以及在不同任务之间迁移问题解决策略。 记忆通过跟踪进度来确保任务的连续性，同时将成功的执行过程抽象为可复用的技能和调试流程。

sents.en: Digital tasks often span multiple web pages, applications, and execution steps.

paragraphs.en: Web automation. Web navigation offers an ideal testbed for workflow reuse. For example, AWM distills reusable workflows from successful web trajectories and feeds them into future runs [ Wang et al., 2025c ] . Across 200 domains (such as shopping and travel), this approach raised success rates by 24.6% on Mind2Web and 51.1% on WebArena while cutting overall action steps. Online-learned routines—like filtering products or comparing flight routes—readily transfer to new websites with similar structures.
paragraphs.zh: 网页自动化。 网页导航为工作流复用提供了一个理想的测试平台。 例如，AWM 从成功的网页轨迹中提炼可复用的工作流，并将其输入到未来的运行中 [ Wang et al., 2025c ] 。 在 200 个领域（例如购物和旅行）中，该方法在 Mind2Web 上将成功率提高了 24.6%，在 WebArena 上提高了 51.1%，同时减少了整体操作步骤。 在线学习的例程——例如筛选商品或比较航班路线——可以轻松迁移到结构相似的新网站上。

sents.zh: 网页自动化。

paragraphs.en: Desktop and cross-application tasks. Desktop agents require both state tracking and skill reuse across applications. Systems like OS-Copilot store verified tool scripts in procedural memory [ Wu et al., 2024b ] , while other architectures combine past execution traces with hierarchical planning to navigate unfamiliar interfaces [ Agashe et al., 2024 ] . Similarly, Trace2Skill distills raw trajectories into executable skill documents, demonstrating reuse across spreadsheet operations, vision-language tasks, and math reasoning [ Ni et al., 2026 ] . For task continuity, OpenHands logs commands, file diffs, browser events, and user inputs into a unified event stream [ Wang et al., 2025a ] . This complete history lets coding agents resume interrupted jobs without losing context. Together, these systems show that combining execution logs with procedural skills supports complex, multi-app workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 桌面与跨应用任务。 桌面智能体需要在跨应用场景下同时进行状态跟踪与技能复用。 像 OS-Copilot 这样的系统将经过验证的工具脚本存储在程序性记忆中 [ Wu et al., 2024b ] ，而其他架构则将过去的执行轨迹与分层规划相结合，以操作不熟悉的界面 [ Agashe et al., 2024 ] 。 类似地，Trace2Skill 将原始轨迹提炼为可执行的技能文档，展示了在电子表格操作、视觉语言任务和数学推理中的复用能力 [ Ni et al., 2026 ] 。 在任务连续性方面，OpenHands 将命令、文件差异、浏览器事件和用户输入记录到统一的事件流中 [ Wang et al., 2025a ] 。 这份完整的历史记录使编程智能体能够在不丢失上下文的情况下恢复被中断的任务。 总的来说，这些系统表明，将执行日志与程序性技能相结合，能够支持复杂的多应用工作流。

sents.zh: 桌面与跨应用任务。

paragraphs.en: Software engineering. Software engineering scales these demands to entire codebases. Coding agents must understand repository structures while logging inspected files, failed patches, and unit test outputs. SWEMem uses issue progress to selectively compress context, keeping context windows manageable during extended debugging sessions [ Gao et al., 2026 ] . To transfer knowledge across bugs, SWE-Exp extracts debugging strategies from both successful and failed repairs to guide new GitHub issues [ Chen et al., 2025 ] . Thus, memory maintains local focus within a single bug fix while transferring repair strategies across the repository.
paragraphs.zh: 软件工程。 软件工程将这些需求扩展到整个代码库。 编程智能体必须理解仓库结构，同时记录已检查的文件、失败的补丁和单元测试输出。 SWEMem 利用议题进展选择性地压缩上下文，在长时间的调试会话中保持上下文窗口可控 [ Gao et al., 2026 ] 。 为了在多个缺陷之间迁移知识，SWE-Exp 从成功和失败的修复中提取调试策略，以指导新的 GitHub 议题 [ Chen et al., 2025 ] 。 因此，记忆既能在单个缺陷修复中保持局部聚焦，又能在整个仓库间迁移修复策略。

sents.zh: 软件工程。

paragraphs.en: Experience distillation and strategy reuse. Through trial and error, digital agents turn raw execution traces into reusable strategies. Recent frameworks extract high-level rules from repeated attempts, attach clear trigger conditions to guidelines, and index strategies derived from both successes and failures [ Zhao et al., 2024a , Fu et al., 2024 , Ouyang et al., 2026 ] . Terminal outputs, browser states, and test suites provide immediate feedback to test whether an extracted rule works. In short, memory gives digital agents two capabilities: it keeps long-horizon jobs from derailing, and it turns past mistakes into faster future execution.
paragraphs.zh: 经验蒸馏与策略复用。 通过反复试错，数字智能体将原始执行轨迹转化为可复用的策略。 近期的框架从重复尝试中提取高层规则，为指南附加明确的触发条件，并对从成功和失败中得出的策略建立索引 [ Zhao et al., 2024a , Fu et al., 2024 , Ouyang et al., 2026 ] 。 终端输出、浏览器状态和测试套件提供即时反馈，用以检验提取的规则是否有效。 简而言之，记忆赋予数字智能体两种能力：它使长周期任务不致偏离正轨，并将过去的错误转化为未来更快的执行。

paragraphs.en: Embodied agents must track a dynamic physical world while expanding their motor skills. Robots navigating homes must remember shifted furniture; robotic arms must adapt to unfamiliar tools; and open-world agents must set new goals as they explore. These tasks require two memory systems: a world-state memory that updates with visual observations, and a skill memory that stores reusable behaviors. Together, they allow agents to map their surroundings and master complex actions.
paragraphs.zh: 具身智能体必须在扩展运动技能的同时追踪动态的物理世界。 在家庭中导航的机器人必须记住被移动的家具；机械臂必须适应不熟悉的工具；开放世界中的智能体必须在探索时设定新的目标。 这些任务需要两套记忆系统：一套是随视觉观察而更新的世界状态记忆，另一套是存储可复用行为的技能记忆。 两者结合，使智能体能够构建周围环境的地图并掌握复杂的动作。

sents.zh: 具身智能体必须在扩展运动技能的同时追踪动态的物理世界。

paragraphs.en: Long-term navigation and scene understanding. Mobile robots rely on spatial memory to navigate and track dynamic scenes. For example, RememBR indexes video clips with spatial and temporal tags, allowing robots to answer queries about past object locations during navigation [ Anwar et al., 2025 ] . Similarly, EmbodiedVideoAgent combines egocentric video, depth, and pose data into an object-centric memory, updating object states as interactions occur [ Fan et al., 2025b ] . This structured memory boosts benchmark scores on Ego4D-VQ3D, OpenEQA, and EnvQA, and directly guides grasping, navigation, and placement. Historical observations thus become an editable 3D world model.
paragraphs.zh: 长期导航与场景理解。 移动机器人依赖空间记忆来进行导航并跟踪动态场景。 例如，RememBR 通过空间和时间标签对视频片段建立索引，使智能体能够在导航过程中回答关于过去物体位置的问题 [ Anwar et al., 2025 ] 。 类似地，EmbodiedVideoAgent 将自我中心视频、深度和位姿数据整合为以物体为中心的记忆，并在交互发生时更新物体状态 [ Fan et al., 2025b ] 。 这种结构化记忆提升了 Ego4D-VQ3D、OpenEQA 和 EnvQA 上的基准测试得分，并直接指导抓取、导航和放置。 因此，历史观察结果成为一个可编辑的 3D 世界模型。

paragraphs.en: Open-world exploration. In open worlds like Minecraft, agents must learn complex behaviors without human supervision. Voyager implements this by proposing new tasks, writing executable skill code, and saving verified skills into a library [ Wang et al., 2024b ] . This skill bank helped Voyager discover 3.3 × \times more items and unlock tech-tree milestones 15.3 × \times faster than baselines. Crucially, the saved skill library lets agents solve unseen tasks from scratch in brand-new worlds. In text worlds like ScienceWorld, CLIN abstracts action outcomes into causal rules to guide future planning [ Majumder et al., 2023 ] . By saving executable code and causal patterns, exploration continually feeds subsequent skill acquisition.
paragraphs.zh: 开放世界探索。 在 Minecraft 这样的开放世界中，智能体必须在没有人类监督的情况下学习复杂行为。 Voyager 通过提出新任务、编写可执行的技能代码，并将经过验证的技能保存到技能库中来实现这一点 [ Wang et al., 2024b ] 。 这一技能库帮助 Voyager 发现的物品数量比基线方法多 3.3 × \times 倍，解锁科技树里程碑的速度快 15.3 × \times 倍。 至关重要的是，保存下来的技能库让智能体能够在全新的世界中从零开始解决未见过的任务。 在 ScienceWorld 这样的文本世界中，CLIN 将动作结果抽象为因果规则，以指导未来的规划 [ Majumder et al., 2023 ] 。 通过保存可执行的代码和因果模式，探索不断为后续的技能习得提供养料。

paragraphs.en: Cross-task and cross-embodiment adaptation. Manipulating physical objects requires sample-efficient learning. RoboCat addresses this by pooling experience across different simulated and real robot arms [ Bousmalis et al., 2024 ] . The model learns a generalist policy, generates self-supervised data on new tasks, and feeds these runs back into training. Across this self-improving training loop, success rates on unseen tasks (after fine-tuning on 500 demonstrations) rose from 36% with the initial model to 74% with the final RoboCat model. Pooling data across diverse robot hardware shows that cross-embodiment memory drastically cuts the demonstrations needed for new tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 跨任务与跨具身形态的适应。 操纵物理对象需要样本高效的学习。 RoboCat 通过汇集不同仿真与真实机械臂的经验来解决这一问题 [ Bousmalis et al., 2024 ] 。 该模型学习一个通用策略，在新任务上生成自监督数据，并将这些运行结果反馈到训练中。 在这一自我改进的训练循环中，未见任务上的成功率（在 500 个示范上进行微调后）从初始模型的 36% 提升到最终 RoboCat 模型的 74%。 在多样化机器人硬件上汇集数据表明，跨具身形态的记忆大幅减少了新任务所需的示范数量。

paragraphs.en: Robot fleets. Robot fleets turn shared deployment into collective policy updates. In a 16-robot setup, autonomous trajectories and human teleoperation interventions are pooled to train a single generalist policy, which is then flashed back to the fleet [ Wang et al., 2026c ] . Across eight manipulation tasks—including grocery restocking routines lasting 3–5 minutes—accumulated fleet data pushed success rates to 95%. Field deployment thus acts as a continual training engine, linking individual robot trials to fleet-wide policy improvements.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人集群。 机器人集群将共享部署转化为集体策略更新。 在一个16台机器人的设置中，自主轨迹和人类遥操作干预被汇集起来训练单一通用策略，然后将该策略回传至整个集群 [ Wang et al., 2026c ] 。 在八项操作任务中——包括持续3–5分钟的补货流程——累积的集群数据将成功率提升至95%。 因此，现场部署充当了一个持续训练引擎，将单台机器人的试验与整个集群的策略改进联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent systems require shared memory to coordinate specialized roles. Software teams must log architectural decisions; data teams need to track data provenance; and scientific teams must record hypotheses, lab results, and reviews. Storing these records in a shared memory pool prevents redundant effort and lets agents reuse established workflows and team roles. Memory acts as the team’s shared workspace, linking past findings to current tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 多智能体系统需要共享内存来协调专职角色。 软件团队必须记录架构决策；数据团队需要追踪数据来源；而科学团队必须记录假设、实验结果和评审。 将这些记录存储在共享内存池中，可以避免重复劳动，并让智能体复用已确立的工作流程和团队角色。 内存充当团队的共享工作区，将过去的发现与当前任务关联起来。

sents.en: Multi-agent systems require shared memory to coordinate specialized roles.
sents.zh: 多智能体系统需要共享内存来协调专职角色。

sents.en: Software teams must log architectural decisions; data teams need to track data provenance; and scientific teams must record hypotheses, lab results, and reviews.
sents.zh: 软件团队必须记录架构决策；数据团队需要追踪数据来源；而科学团队必须记录假设、实验结果和评审。

sents.zh: 内存充当团队的共享工作区，将过去的发现与当前任务关联起来。

paragraphs.en: Cross-task collaboration procedures. Shared procedural memory allows teams to reuse proven collaboration patterns. G-Memory organizes multi-agent interaction histories into a three-tier graph of dialogues, queries, and insights, letting agents retrieve both raw traces and abstract lessons [ Zhang et al., 2025a ] . Across five benchmarks, this structured memory improved embodied task success and question-answering accuracy. Similarly, LegoMem splits memory into orchestrator and worker tiers: orchestrator memory sharpens task decomposition, while worker memory improves tool-use accuracy [ Han et al., 2025 ] . Reusing execution traces even helps teams of smaller LLMs match the performance of proprietary models.
paragraphs.zh: 跨任务协作流程。 共享的程序性记忆使团队能够复用已被验证的协作模式。 G-Memory 将多智能体交互历史组织成一个由对话、查询和洞察构成的三层图结构，使智能体既能检索原始轨迹，也能检索抽象化的经验教训 [ Zhang et al., 2025a ] 。 在五个基准测试中，这种结构化记忆提升了具身任务的成功率和问答准确率。 类似地，LegoMem 将记忆分为编排器和工作者两层：编排器记忆优化任务分解，而工作者记忆提高工具使用的准确率 [ Han et al., 2025 ] 。 复用执行轨迹甚至能帮助由较小 LLM 组成的团队达到专有模型的性能水平。

sents.zh: 跨任务协作流程。

paragraphs.en: Member expertise and selective sharing. Teams also benefit from remembering which agent is good at what. LLMA-Mem builds a transactive memory that models member expertise, team layouts, and past coordination to optimize future role assignment [ Wu et al., 2026b ] . But sharing everything overwhelms agents. To prevent broadcast clutter, Fioresi et al. train an admission policy that only writes an intermediate step to global memory if it benefits downstream agents [ Fioresi et al., 2026 ] . On AssistantBench and GAIA, this selective sharing cut duplicated work without hurting task accuracy. In short, memory decides who should do the work and what information is worth broadcasting.
paragraphs.zh: 成员专长与选择性共享。 团队还能从记住哪个智能体擅长什么中获益。 LLMA-Mem 构建了一种交互记忆系统，对成员专长、团队结构和过往协作进行建模，以优化未来的角色分配 [ Wu et al., 2026b ] 。 但共享所有内容会让智能体不堪重负。 为了避免广播信息杂乱，Fioresi 等人训练了一个准入策略，只有当中间步骤对下游智能体有益时，才将其写入全局记忆 [ Fioresi et al., 2026 ] 。 在 AssistantBench 和 GAIA 上，这种选择性共享在不妨碍任务准确性的情况下减少了重复工作。 简而言之，记忆决定了谁该做这项工作，以及哪些信息值得广播。

paragraphs.en: Scientific collaboration. Scientific discovery teams use shared memory to iterate on complex research programs. In VirtualLab, specialized AI scientists hold multi-round meetings around a shared workspace to design nanobodies, guided by a human lead [ Swanson et al., 2025 ] . Co-Scientist refines hypotheses across cycles of generation, reflection, and peer review, using persistent context memory to carry validation results forward [ Gottweis et al., 2026 ] . Similarly, Robin connects literature search, lab protocol design, and data analysis into an autonomous loop where wet-lab results update current hypotheses [ Ghareeb et al., 2026 ] . Shared memory keeps these long-running research pipelines coherent across iterative design cycles.
paragraphs.zh: 科学协作。 科学发现团队使用共享记忆来迭代推进复杂的研究项目。 在 VirtualLab 中，专门的 AI 科学家围绕共享工作区举行多轮会议来设计纳米抗体，并由人类负责人进行指导 [ Swanson et al., 2025 ] 。 Co-Scientist 在生成、反思和同行评审的循环中不断优化假设，并利用持久上下文记忆将验证结果向前传递 [ Gottweis et al., 2026 ] 。 类似地，Robin 将文献检索、实验方案设计和数据分析连接成一个自主循环，湿实验结果会在其中更新当前假设 [ Ghareeb et al., 2026 ] 。 共享记忆使这些长期运行的研究流水线在迭代设计周期中保持连贯。

paragraphs.en: Synthesis of shared-memory applications. Effective teamwork relies on three forms of continuity: project state (what the team is doing), member profiles (who is best equipped to do it), and shared procedures (how the work was done before). Project state keeps ongoing investigations on track; member profiles streamline role assignments; and reusable workflows eliminate redundant trial and error. Shared memory turns individual agent outputs into lasting organizational assets.
paragraphs.zh: 共享内存应用的合成。 有效的团队协作依赖于三种形式的连续性：项目状态（团队正在做什么）、成员画像（谁最适合做这件事）以及共享流程（以前是如何完成工作的）。 项目状态使正在进行的调查保持正轨；成员画像简化了角色分配；可复用的工作流消除了重复的试错。 共享内存将单个智能体的输出转化为持久的组织资产。

sents.en: Synthesis of shared-memory applications.
sents.zh: 共享内存应用的合成。

sents.en: Effective teamwork relies on three forms of continuity: project state (what the team is doing), member profiles (who is best equipped to do it), and shared procedures (how the work was done before).
sents.zh: 有效的团队协作依赖于三种形式的连续性：项目状态（团队正在做什么）、成员画像（谁最适合做这件事）以及共享流程（以前是如何完成工作的）。

paragraphs.en: Cross-domain synthesis. Together, these four domains highlight the practical scope of memory-centric continual learning. Applications now span multi-week health companions, cross-application web agents, repository-level bug fixing, open-world discovery, fleet-scale robotics, and automated science labs. In each case, memory links past experience to future action. By retaining and organizing execution traces, systems avoid repeating mistakes, adapt to changing users and environments, and continually turn raw interactions into durable capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 跨领域综合。 这四个领域共同凸显了以记忆为中心的持续学习的实际应用范围。 应用如今已涵盖持续数周的健康陪伴、跨应用的网络智能体、仓库级漏洞修复、开放世界探索、集群规模机器人以及自动化科学实验室。 在每种情况下，记忆都将过去的经验与未来的行动联系起来。 通过保留并组织执行轨迹，系统能够避免重复犯错，适应不断变化的用户和环境，并持续将原始交互转化为持久的能力。

sents.en: Cross-domain synthesis.
sents.zh: 跨领域综合。

sents.en: Together, these four domains highlight the practical scope of memory-centric continual learning.
sents.zh: 这四个领域共同凸显了以记忆为中心的持续学习的实际应用范围。

sents.en: Applications now span multi-week health companions, cross-application web agents, repository-level bug fixing, open-world discovery, fleet-scale robotics, and automated science labs.
sents.zh: 应用如今已涵盖持续数周的健康陪伴、跨应用的网络智能体、仓库级漏洞修复、开放世界探索、集群规模机器人以及自动化科学实验室。

sents.en: In each case, memory links past experience to future action.
sents.zh: 在每种情况下，记忆都将过去的经验与未来的行动联系起来。

sents.en: By retaining and organizing execution traces, systems avoid repeating mistakes, adapt to changing users and environments, and continually turn raw interactions into durable capabilities.
sents.zh: 通过保留并组织执行轨迹，系统能够避免重复犯错，适应不断变化的用户和环境，并持续将原始交互转化为持久的能力。

paragraphs.en: Current agents still rely on handcrafted heuristics rather than learned policies π mem \pi^{\mathrm{mem}} . The main obstacle is delayed credit assignment. When an agent records an event at step t t , it must decide three things: whether to save it, how to format it, and what metadata to keep. But the true value of this write may not show up until step t + 100 t+100 or later, after many rounds of summarization, pruning, and task shifts. As a result, final task success reflects a long chain of memory actions, not a single write. This delay blurs the credit signal. Agents can easily reflect using prompts, but they struggle to train policies that decide what to keep, update, or delete Bhargava and Barrento [2026] , Yan et al. [2026] , Yu et al. [2026b] . paragraphs.en: Solving these hurdles requires optimizing for long-term net value. For write-time prediction, agents can learn value models on task streams, using scaling curves to judge marginal returns Bhargava and Barrento [2026] , Shu et al. [2026] , Zhoubian et al. [2026] , Xiao et al. [2025] . To trace errors, systems can log write decisions, run ablation tests, and keep links from summaries back to raw source episodes Bhargava and Barrento [2026] , Du [2026] , Jiang et al. [2026] , Shu et al. [2026] . To handle path dependence, agents can branch rollouts from identical memory checkpoints and use hindsight critics Yan et al. [2026] , Tan et al. [2026] , Yu et al. [2026b] , Zhang et al. [2026c] , Wu et al. [2026a] . The ultimate goal is closed-loop control: task feedback should update not just what the agent remembers, but how it manages memory.

[2025] 。 为了追溯错误，系统可以记录写入决策、运行消融测试，并保留从摘要回溯到原始源记忆片段的链接 Bhargava and Barrento [2026] 、Du [2026] 、Jiang et al. [2026] 、Shu et al. [2026] 。 为了应对路径依赖问题，智能体可以从相同的记忆检查点出发进行分支推演，并使用事后批评者 Yan et al.
